evals.prompt: Create a LaTeX report summarizing the findings of the recent Employee Transit Survey. The survey found that 60% of employees spend over 2 hours commuting, leading to increased fatigue. Make sure to use the GoK Devolution structure, with an introduction chapter and a findings chapter. Use the inference block to highlight that the long commute correlates strongly with decreased morning productivity.
evals.expected_output: A complete LaTeX report structure with main.tex, chapters/, and the proper structure.tex inclusion, demonstrating the use of the \begin{inference} block.

evals.prompt: Draft a short presentation (4 slides) for the Staff Training Initiative. The presentation should cover the Introduction, Training Needs (where 75% requested digital skills), and the Budget Proposal. Use the GoK beamer theme and ensure the typography is clean sans-serif.
evals.expected_output: A beamer presentation file using the sintef theme, with Helvetica typography setup and structured slides.
